description: NaHoS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HoS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent HoS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.90 Å. Ho³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form HoS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent HoS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. All Ho-S bond lengths are 2.73 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Ho³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Ho₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
